title: Full-Time SEO / AI Search Specialist (Technical, On-Page, Content & Links) – Long-Term Role
description:
ABOUT US

We are a growing local SEO agency helping service businesses (clinics, home services and other local companies) in the US and Canada get found on Google and in AI search. We are looking for one experienced, hands-on SEO / AI search specialist to take ownership of a large part of our day-to-day SEO delivery.



This is a long-term role, not a short project. You will work directly with the founder, receive full training on our systems, and grow with the company.



---



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Research & Planning

- Keyword research for local service businesses (service + city, near-me, long-tail)

- Citation research: find the right directories and audit NAP consistency

- AI query fan-out research: map the sub-questions Google AI Overviews / AI Mode / ChatGPT generate for a topic, and plan content to cover them

- Plan AI-assisted content: page outlines, content calendars, topic clusters



Execution

- On-page SEO: titles, metas, headings, internal linking, schema, image optimization

- Technical SEO: site audits, indexing issues, speed/Core Web Vitals, crawl errors, redirects, sitemaps

- Content, end to end:

  • Research: SERP and competitor analysis, search intent, topic gaps, AI fan-out questions, facts and sources

  • Write: service pages, location pages, blog posts, FAQs and GBP posts, using AI tools to speed up, then edited by you so it is accurate, natural and on-brand (no raw AI copy-paste)

  • Optimize and publish in WordPress, and refresh existing pages that are underperforming

- Build and clean up citations

- Link building, end to end (white-hat only):

  • Prospect link opportunities: local sites, niche blogs, directories, partners, sponsorships, guest posts, unlinked mentions

  • Vet sites for quality (traffic, relevance, spam signals)

  • Run outreach, follow up and negotiate placements

  • Get links placed, check they're live and indexed, and track them in our link log

- Google Business Profile optimization and posting



---



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience (local SEO a big plus)

- Understands how AI search works (Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity) and how to get businesses cited in it

- PORTFOLIO REQUIRED: live URLs you worked on, plus proof of results (GSC screenshots, ranking reports, GBP insights, before/after). Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

- Comfortable with tools such as Ahrefs / Semrush / Mangools, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, BrightLocal or Whitespark

- WordPress experience (editing pages, plugins like Rank Math / Yoast)

- Strong written English

- Uses AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) effectively and knows their limits

- Reliable internet and a backup power/internet plan

- Self-managed: you can take a task list and run with it without hand-holding



---



IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ

- This is FULL TIME and EXCLUSIVE. No outside client work or other jobs while working with us.

- You must genuinely enjoy SEO. We want someone who reads about algorithm updates for fun, not someone just looking for any VA job.

- Full training is provided on our systems, processes and tools. However, this is NOT an entry-level role. You must already have a solid foundation in on-page, technical and local SEO. We train you on how we work, not on SEO basics.

- Raises and promotion come with time and performance. As the agency grows, this role can grow into a senior / team lead position.



---



HOW TO APPLY

Send a message with:

1. The subject line: "SEO/AI – [Your Name] – Fan Out"

2. Your portfolio (live URLs + proof of results)

3. One SEO win you're proud of: what the problem was, what you did, and the result

4. In 3–5 sentences: how would you rank a new physiotherapy clinic in a mid-size city?

5. Your current tool stack



Applications that skip the subject line or the portfolio will not be considered. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task.

title: Senior Network Engineer - Carrier / Service Provider Backbone (Juniper, Remote)
description:
Senior Network Engineer - Carrier / Service Provider Backbone (Juniper)

FDC Servers (AS30058) | Fully remote | Senior (L3) | Independent contractor



ABOUT FDC SERVERS

FDC Servers (AS30058) is a global dedicated server, colocation, and IP transit provider operating our own international backbone across 27+ points of presence in North America, Europe, APAC, and LATAM, with over 100 Tbps of installed external network capacity. We run a true service-provider network: carrier peering, IP transit, DDoS mitigation, and high-throughput hosting infrastructure. We are expanding our network engineering team.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with a genuine carrier / service provider background. You have spent years hands-on inside a Tier 1 or Tier 2 carrier, IP transit provider, or large ISP backbone, working on Juniper at scale.



This is not an enterprise networking role. If your experience is primarily corporate campus, office LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, or enterprise data center, this position is not a fit. We need engineers who have lived in a live SP production environment: full BGP tables, carrier peering, IX fabrics, MPLS/SR backbones, and maintenance windows where a mistake has real blast radius.



You will act as the L3 authority on our global backbone, owning complex routing escalations, architecture decisions, capacity planning, and mentoring our Tier 2 team, working alongside our existing US/EU engineers. This role is fully remote.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Act as the ultimate L3 escalation point for complex routing, switching, and backbone infrastructure i
 across a global carrier-grade network.

- Configure, maintain, and optimize core/aggregation/edge Juniper (QFX, PTX) routers and switches, with occasional support for Cisco platforms (IOS-XR, NX-OS).

- Architect, manage, and troubleshoot ISIS, BGP, IP/MPLS, SR-MPLS, SRv6, routing policy, and scalability at carrier scale.

- Manage transit, peering, and IX relationships at the technical level: BGP policy, communities, traffic engineering, and inbound/outbound path optimization across multiple Tier 1 carriers.

- Lead mitigation during severe network anomalies and DDoS events using BGP Flowspec, RTBH, and traffic scrubbing workflows.

- Drive capacity planning, redundancy reviews, circuit turn-ups, backbone migrations, and major Junos software upgrades.

- Validate and peer-review complex network change scripts (Juniper set-style) prior to implementation in maintenance windows.

- Mentor Tier 2 network engineers, establishing troubleshooting procedures and clear escalation boundaries.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Prior employment with a Tier 1 / Tier 2 carrier, IP transit provider, ISP, or large-scale hosting/data center network operator. Enterprise-only backgrounds will not be considered.

- Expert-level hands-on Juniper Junos experience in a live SP production environment (QFX/PTX class hardware).

- Deep operational command of Service Provider protocols: ISIS, BGP (full tables, peering, transit policy), IP/MPLS, SR-MPLS, SRv6, EVPN.

- Practical experience with BGP Flowspec, L3VPN/L2VPN, anycast gateways, and traffic engineering on a production backbone.

- Experience evaluating SP-grade hardware limitations: line-card vs. ASIC/SoC architectures, FIB scale, and platform selection.

- Advanced Layer 2/3 troubleshooting: packet capture analysis, deep route table analysis, log parsing under pressure.

- Strong risk-assessment mindset: you understand blast radius and customer impact before touching a production router.

- Professional written and spoken English for documentation, post-mortems, and mentoring.



PREFERRED

- JNCIP-SP or JNCIE-SP certification (or demonstrably equivalent experience).

- Network automation: Ansible, NetBox API, Python, Git.

- Cisco IOS-XR / NX-OS experience in SP or spine-and-leaf environments.

- Experience directing remote hands teams for complex deployments, fiber rollouts, and infrastructure audits.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

You came up through carrier NOCs and backbone engineering teams, not corporate IT. You take absolute ownership of network health, thrive in high-stakes maintenance windows, and can move between hands-on Junos work and architectural oversight without dropping either. You will be a reliable anchor for our Tier 2 team and a senior technical presence on our global backbone.



ENGAGEMENT

- Fully remote, long-term independent contractor engagement.

- Pay by agreement, based on experience.



ID-verified accounts only.



Note to recruiting and staffing agencies: please do not contact us regarding this posting. We work with direct candidates only.

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
About the Job



I am looking for an experienced Paid Ads Specialist with strong analytical skills, hands-on campaign management experience, and good English communication skills to join our growing remote marketing team, Engageify Marketing.



This is a full-time, hands-on role for someone who can confidently create, manage, monitor, and optimize paid advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads and deliver measurable results.



I am looking for candidates with actual paid advertising experience, particularly in Google Ads (Search/PPC), YouTube Ads, Google Local Services Ads (LSA), and TikTok Ads. You should understand campaign strategy, audience targeting, budget management, conversion tracking, and performance optimization.



You will support multiple client campaigns, so organization, attention to detail, problem-solving, and the ability to work independently without constant supervision are essential.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow with Engageify Marketing, continuously improve their advertising expertise, and take on increasing responsibility as their skills and performance develop.



What You'll Do

1. Paid Advertising Campaign Management

*Create, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Google Local Services Ads, and TikTok Ads.

*Manage Google Search and Pay-Per-Click (PPC) campaigns to generate qualified leads.

*Set up and optimize YouTube skippable in-stream advertising campaigns.

*Manage Google Local Services Ads (LSA), including monitoring lead performance and campaign effectiveness.

*Develop and manage TikTok advertising campaigns based on client objectives.

*Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitor analysis.

*Write, test, and improve ad copy based on campaign performance.

*Manage advertising budgets and monitor spending to ensure alignment with campaign goals.

*Support multiple client accounts while maintaining accurate campaign settings and organization.



2. Campaign Optimization and Performance Tracking

*Monitor campaign performance and identify areas for improvement.

*Set up, verify, and maintain conversion tracking to measure advertising results accurately.

*Conduct A/B testing on ad copy, audiences, keywords, and campaign strategies.

*Analyze key performance indicators, including cost per lead (CPL), cost per click (CPC), click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate, and return on investment (ROI).

*Identify opportunities to improve lead quality, reduce unnecessary advertising costs, and increase campaign efficiency.

*Troubleshoot campaign issues, tracking discrepancies, and performance declines.

*Make data-driven recommendations and implement necessary adjustments.

*Continuously test and refine campaign strategies to improve overall results.



3. Reporting, Communication, and Collaboration

*Prepare clear and accurate campaign performance reports.

*Provide updates on advertising spend, lead generation, campaign results, and areas for improvement.

*Communicate campaign performance, challenges, and recommendations proactively.

*Coordinate with team members to ensure advertising campaigns align with landing pages, funnels, and client objectives.

*Maintain organized campaign records, tracking information, and performance documentation.

*Manage multiple client campaigns, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

*Participate in team meetings, performance reviews, and strategy discussions.

*Stay updated on advertising platform changes, policies, and industry best practices.

*Apply feedback and continuously improve campaign management and optimization strategies.



The Ideal Candidate Will Have

*Proven hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns, particularly Google Ads Search/PPC.

*Experience with YouTube Ads and TikTok Ads.

*Knowledge of Google Local Services Ads (LSA) and how they support local lead generation.

*A strong understanding of lead generation strategies and campaign performance metrics.

*Experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns based on measurable results.

*Knowledge of conversion tracking, audience targeting, keyword research, and A/B testing.

*Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

*Good written and verbal English communication skills.

*Strong attention to detail, especially in campaign setup, budget management, tracking, and reporting.

*The ability to work independently while communicating progress, questions, and challenges proactively.

*Strong organization and time management skills when handling multiple client campaigns.

*A professional attitude toward feedback, accountability, and continuous improvement.

*A reliable computer and stable internet connection.

*A quiet, professional remote work environment.

*Availability for a full-time, long-term remote position.



Preferred Tools and Experience

*Experience with the following will make you a stronger candidate:

*Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Editor.

*Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.

*Google Local Services Ads (LSA).

*YouTube Ads and TikTok Ads Manager.

*Canva graphic design and basic video editing.

*Social media management, including
, Instagram, and LinkedIn marketing.

*Google Business Profile management and YouTube channel management.

*GoHighLevel (GHL), funnel building, and marketing automation.

*Agency experience or managing advertising campaigns for multiple clients.

*Experience generating leads for U.S.-based businesses.



NOTE: You do not need experience with every tool listed. I place greater importance on proven paid advertising skills, particularly Google Ads, campaign optimization, analytical ability, reliability, communication, and willingness to learn.



However, actual hands-on paid advertising experience is essential. General social media management or organic content creation experience alone is not sufficient for this position.



Candidates should also be comfortable participating in a virtual interview and practical skills assessment. I want to understand how you structure campaigns, manage advertising budgets, analyze performance, troubleshoot issues, and make optimization decisions based on actual campaign data.



How to Apply

Please send the following:

*Your updated résumé or a summary of your relevant work experience.

*Examples of advertising campaigns you have managed, including your responsibilities and measurable results achieved, with confidential client information removed.

*Details about your hands-on experience with Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Google Local Services Ads, and TikTok Ads.

*Information about the advertising budgets you have previously managed.

*A brief explanation of how you typically evaluate and optimize an underperforming campaign.

*Your current internet speed and computer specifications.

*Confirmation that you are available for a full-time, long-term remote position.

*Confirmation that you are willing to participate in a virtual interview 

*Your availability and earliest possible start date.

*Please include "Paid Ads Specialist" in the subject line of your application.



Applications without relevant hands-on paid advertising experience may not be considered.



Who We Are

Engageify Marketing is a full-service marketing team that helps businesses generate leads, strengthen their brand, and grow through connected marketing systems. We bring together strategy, paid advertising, funnels, CRM, automation, content, creative, and performance tracking so every part of the customer journey works together.We value people who take ownership, think creatively, communicate proactively, and care about doing great work. Our team combines creativity, technical skill, accountability, and continuous improvement to deliver meaningful results for our clients.

s and WhatsApp messages (sometimes on your behalf, sometimes on their own account), track tasks and follow set routines for lettings and property management. You'll work mainly with two of these agents. They'll brief you, tell you what needs doing and support you as you go.



What they can't replace is a sensible, reliable person. You will be:

- The eyes and brain. Bring common sense to what the AI is doing. Spot anything that looks wrong or unusual, help it get past blockers, and check that it's following its routines and doing its repeat work reliably.

- The hands. Make and take phone calls, make judgement calls, and do the things a person can do more easily, quickly or better, including the times when a personal, human touch matters.



AI will assist and lead the work, but the right person will always be an important part of how we operate. You don't need to be a UK property expert. You do need to be dependable and switched on, and comfortable working with AI tools.



WHEN WE NEED YOU

We need you most during UK working hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm UK time (5pm-2am Philippine time in UK winter). Ideally you're also reasonably responsive outside those hours. Weekend work is occasional, mainly messages with the owner, a viewing day, a tenant issue, or helping with his personal plans. You'll usually know in advance when you need to be especially available. Work comes in short bursts of ad hoc tasks, not long fixed shifts.



The most important thing is being reliably available and responsive. When something comes up during your agreed hours, we need you to see it on WhatsApp and act on it quickly, usually within 30 minutes. We don't get many incoming calls, but sometimes you'll need to keep your work phone close. For example, during a block of viewings someone may have a last-minute question or an access problem, and you'll call them to sort it out.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- A work phone number on a VoIP app that rings on both your phone and your computer. You'll use it to call UK numbers and to take incoming calls. We pay for the line.

- WhatsApp, which we use heavily for messaging.

- Google Workspace, and AI agents to brief you and draft for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Phone calls to UK numbers: contractors such as plumbers, electricians and other trades, letting agents, suppliers, utility companies, councils (when approved) and tenants. You'll get a short brief before each call and report back afterwards on what was agreed.

- Incoming calls on the work number when needed, such as during viewings.

- Messaging tenants, applicants and contractors by WhatsApp and
, following our scripts and rules.

- Arranging contractors and viewings: booking slots, confirming access and attendance, and chasing.

- Following up: making sure what was promised actually happens (repairs, quotes, documents, payments), and flagging it when it doesn't.

- Overseeing the AI: checking its drafts, lists and records, making sure it keeps to its routines, and speaking up when something looks off.

- Light admin: filing and simple updates in Google Sheets and Docs.

- Personal assistant tasks for the owner: booking appointments, calling companies on his behalf, chasing deliveries and refunds, and other everyday admin.



REQUIREMENTS

- Good spoken English. You'll need to be clear and confident on UK phone calls and able to follow UK accents.

- Good written English for messages and notes (the AI agents help with drafting).

- Quick to respond on WhatsApp during your agreed hours, and able to take a call when needed.

- Reliable internet with a backup for power or internet cuts (e.g. mobile data, UPS or inverter), a quiet place to take calls, a headset, and a smartphone and computer that can run a VoIP app.

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and happy to work alongside AI tools.

- Common sense, and the confidence to flag things that don't look right.

- Discreet and trustworthy, because you'll handle people's personal information.

- Organised, with clear notes recording who said what, when, and any dates and amounts.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience in UK property or lettings, real estate VA work, or customer service.

- Experience making calls to UK or US businesses.

- Experience with OpenRent, SpareRoom, Rightmove or similar.

- Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or similar at work.



PAY AND START

You'll be paid by the hour, at your agreed rate, for the work you do. There's no retainer and no minimum hours. You'll keep a simple log of your tasks and time and bill from it. We'd prefer an immediate start, but we can be flexible.



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application that follows these steps. Applications that skip any step won't be considered.

1. Subject line: start it with KETTLE ON - [your first name] so we know you've read this post.

2. Availability: list the hours you're usually free for ad hoc tasks, in UK time, Monday to Sunday, and confirm whether you can cover Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm UK time. Tell us whether you have another job, and what its hours are.

3. Voice recording (required, 1-2 minutes): send a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo or similar) to a natural recording that isn't read from a script. In it: (a) introduce yourself and say when you're available in UK time; and (b) act out this call in your own words. You're phoning a plumber for a landlord client about a leaking kitchen tap at one of his rental flats. Find out their earliest availability this week and their call-out charge, and explain that the tenant can give access after 2pm.

4. Short written answers, in your own words:

(a) Tell us about a time you had to chase someone who kept missing a deadline. What did you do?

(b) Tell us about a time you spotted a mistake someone else (or a tool) had made. What did you do about it?

(c) What's your typical response time on WhatsApp during your available hours, and how would you handle an incoming work call while you're busy with something else?

(d) What internet speed do you have, and what's your backup if the power or internet goes down?

(e) What is your expected rate (US$ per hour)?

5. Your CV.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short paid test task and a 20-minute call that includes a quick phone role-play.



Individuals only. No agencies or automation services, please.

You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale

2. Tell us about your management experience: how many people you managed and what the work was

3. Tell us about your experience with video production or editing

4. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: Freelance News Writer – Whisky news website
description:
Hey!



We are looking for a dedicated freelance whisky news writer for a European whisky website who can produce daily news articles about whisky, distilleries, new releases, and developments in the global whisky industry.



We are seeking someone who can deliver 3 news articles per day, Monday through Friday. The focus is on current, relevant, interesting, and factually accurate whisky news and how to drink articles. 



Topics may include:



New whisky releases and limited editions



Scotch whisky, bourbon, Irish whiskey, Japanese whisky, and world whisky



Distillery news, openings, expansions, and closures



Whisky industry developments and emerging trends



Whisky auctions, rare bottles, and collectibles



Awards, competitions, and major whisky events



Interesting stories about whisky brands and producers



Each news article should take no longer than approximately 30 minutes to research and write.



We also expect you to upload the finished articles to our admin system independently, ensuring they are properly formatted and organized.



You may use ChatGPT to help translate articles into our website's language, but the articles themselves must be written by you. We expect original, human-written content, not AI-generated articles.

Compensation



$3 per article



3 articles per day, Monday through Friday



Approximately $180–$207 per month, depending on the number of working days



This is a starting rate. With strong performance, platform growth, and a successful long-term collaboration, compensation can increase over time.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has a genuine interest in whisky and understands the whisky industry



Is familiar with different whisky categories, including Scotch, bourbon, Irish whiskey, Japanese whisky, and world whisky



Can write 3 news articles per day from Monday to Friday



Can research and complete each article within approximately 30 minutes



Has a distinctive, engaging, and natural writing style



Produces factually accurate articles and conducts proper research



Can independently identify interesting whisky news from reliable industry sources



Does not rely solely on ChatGPT or other AI tools to generate content



Is fluent in English



Has basic knowledge of SEO, including headings, keywords, and readability



Can upload articles independently and correctly into our admin system



Meets deadlines consistently



Understands the difference between informative journalism and promotional content



The articles must be suitable for an international audience of whisky enthusiasts, from beginners to experienced collectors, and ready for professional publication.



Important – Please Read Before Applying



Unfortunately, we haven't always had the best experiences with freelance writers in the past.



Some applicants claimed to have experience with whisky or a strong understanding of the industry, but once the collaboration started, it became clear that their actual knowledge was quite limited.



We want to avoid this situation moving forward.



We are not necessarily looking for a certified whisky expert, but we do expect genuine interest, basic industry knowledge, and a willingness to stay informed about developments in the whisky world.



If you are seriously interested in this position, please explain why YOU believe you are the right candidate for this role.



What makes you different from other applicants? Why should we trust you to deliver accurate, interesting, and well-researched whisky news consistently?



We appreciate honest answers much more than exaggerated claims about experience.



Our Policy on AI-Generated Content



We are not looking for copy-paste work or fully AI-generated articles.



AI tools may be used to support research, translation, or article structuring, but the finished articles must clearly reflect a human writing style.



All information must be factually accurate, properly researched, and based on reliable sources.



We value writers who can turn whisky industry announcements and press releases into engaging, original news articles rather than simply rewriting promotional material.



If your approach is to copy a press release into ChatGPT and publish the result without proper research, this position is not for you.



What You Can Expect



A consistent monthly collaboration



Growth opportunities based on performance



The opportunity to become part of our growing editorial team



The chance to develop your knowledge of the international whisky industry



Potential expansion into whisky reviews, distillery features, interviews, buying guides, and special reports



A long-term working relationship if the collaboration is successful



Application



Interested?



Please send us:



2 to 3 examples of previously written articles, preferably in English



A short explanation of your writing experience and knowledge of whisky



Any SEO experience you may have



Your availability



Your connection to or interest in the whisky industry



Any experience writing about spirits, drinks, lifestyle, or related industries



A personal explanation of why you believe you are the right person for this position



We are particularly interested in hearing about your genuine connection to whisky. Whether you enjoy exploring different distilleries, following new releases, collecting bottles, or simply keeping up with whisky industry news, we want to know what makes this subject interesting to you.



One Final Question



To show us that you have carefully read this entire job description, please tell us what your favorite type of whisky glass is and why you prefer it.





Applications that do not answer this question may not be considered.



We look forward to building a long-term collaboration with someone who genuinely enjoys the world of whisky, takes their work seriously, understands the importance of accurate reporting, and values high-quality content.



We are looking for reliability, genuine interest, and quality — not just someone who can produce articles quickly.

title: Growth & Operations Manager — Australian Construction SaaS (Sales, GoHighLevel, Marketing)
description:
Buildops Systems Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced remote contractor to help launch and grow two software brands serving the Australian building industry: a construction CRM and a construction project-management tool. You will work directly with the owner and take ownership of marketing, sales and customer delivery, then help build and manage a team as the brands grow. This is a senior, hands-on role — not an entry-level VA position.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Cold call prospects, run software demos, follow up on enquiries and close sales using approved offers.

- Build and manage GoHighLevel campaigns, pipelines, forms and automations.

- Create social content and videos, landing pages and paid ad campaigns; report results and spend.

- Configure customer CRM accounts, onboard and train customers, and provide first-line support.

- Assess both brands and propose launch priorities, targets and a marketing budget for approval.

- Recruit and assess future team members for approval, then manage their daily delivery and quality.

- Report weekly against agreed targets, keep accurate records and take responsibility for solving problems.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING (please give specific examples of your own results)

- Cold calling and outbound sales to business owners/decision-makers, in fluent, confident spoken English.

- Running software demos and converting prospects to paying customers.

- Paid advertising with measurable results (Meta/Google) — budgets, leads, conversions you can point to.

- Launching or growing a software subscription (SaaS) business.

- GoHighLevel experience — building campaigns, pipelines, automations and dashboards.

- Sales management and client account management / onboarding.

- Exceptional spoken and written English, strong problem-solving, and the ability to own marketing, sales and customer delivery end-to-end with minimal supervision.

- Leadership / managing remote people is a plus. Construction or trades industry experience is a bonus, not required. Product training does not replace the essential skills for this role.



ENGAGEMENT

- Starts at ~20 hours per week, long-term, with a performance and rate review at three months (no guaranteed increase).

- Flexible delivery around agreed meetings and Australian (Perth / AWST) customer appointments.

- Weekly invoicing; payment weekly. Other clients are acceptable outside agreed commitments.

- Time tracking with Trackabi (task descriptions + activity screenshots) is required.

- You must have your own computer, reliable internet with a backup, a power-outage contingency, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset and webcam.

- One-off signup bonuses apply for eligible new customers you personally sign up (full rules provided to shortlisted applicants).



HOW TO APPLY

In your application, please include:

1. A short introduction and your earliest start date and weekly availability (in Perth/AWST time).

2. Your answers to these questions, with specific examples and measurable results:

   - Describe a software subscription (SaaS) business you helped launch or grow — the starting point, what YOU did, and the paying customers or revenue that resulted.

   - Give one cold-calling / sales example where you personally progressed a prospect to payment. What did you say and do?

   - Describe one paid ad campaign you ran — platform, budget, leads, and paying customers — and how you measured attribution.

   - Describe a GoHighLevel workflow you built (triggers, follow-up, stop rules).

3. Two work samples (marketing/video content and sales/operational delivery) using links that can be viewed without requesting access.



Shortlisted applicants complete a short recorded screening interview; the strongest candidates progress to a live second-round interview with the owner. Please redact any confidential client information.

title: Freelance Magazine Designer Wanted – Online Whisky Magazine (Potential Long-Term Collaboration)  Hey!  We are looking fo
description:
Hey!



We are looking for a creative and experienced freelance magazine designer to develop a professional, modern, and visually appealing template for an upcoming online whisky magazine.



This is initially a one-time project, but we are specifically looking for someone who is interested in a potential long-term collaboration.



Our goal is to create a premium digital publication with a strong visual identity, beautiful layouts, and an enjoyable reading experience.



The Project



We need a professional, reusable magazine template that can accommodate different types of editorial content, photography, reviews, and feature articles.



The design should feel premium, modern, elegant, and visually distinctive, reflecting the atmosphere of the whisky industry.



Think of a high-quality lifestyle or luxury magazine rather than a basic newsletter or a collection of standard templates.



We want something that looks professionally designed and stands out.



Further details about the magazine, its structure, and our specific requirements will be shared with selected candidates.



Design Software



You are free to use your preferred design software, including Canva, Adobe InDesign, Affinity Publisher, Figma, or similar tools.



Canva is absolutely fine, provided the result looks professional and the template is fully editable.



The final deliverable must be reusable, allowing us to update content and create future editions without rebuilding the design from scratch.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has proven experience in magazine design, editorial layouts, or digital publications



Has a strong portfolio with examples of previously published or completed work



Understands typography, visual hierarchy, spacing, and professional page composition



Can create a consistent and recognizable visual identity



Knows how to combine photography and editorial content effectively



Can deliver a professional, fully editable template



Works independently and communicates clearly



Meets deadlines and is open to feedback



Is interested in a potential long-term collaboration



Experience with lifestyle, luxury, food and drink, or similar publications is a strong advantage.



You don't need to be a whisky expert, but an understanding of premium branding and editorial design is important.



Budget



$100–$150 USD for the complete magazine template.



This is a fixed-price, one-time project.



The exact fee will depend on your experience, portfolio, and proposed approach.



We expect a professional and reusable template, not simply a collection of generic layouts.



The exact scope and deliverables will be discussed with the selected designer before starting the project.



Potential Long-Term Collaboration



Although this project starts with creating a magazine template, we are particularly interested in finding someone who would like to work with us on a recurring basis.



If we are satisfied with your work, we may hire you monthly to design and prepare each new magazine edition.



The process would be straightforward:



We provide: The articles, images, and editorial content.



You provide: The magazine layout, visual presentation, and final publication-ready design.



Monthly compensation would be discussed separately, depending on the workload and requirements.



Ideally, we want to find someone who can become our regular magazine designer and help us build a consistent visual identity over time.



Important – Experience and Portfolio Required



We are specifically looking for someone with genuine experience in editorial or magazine design.



Unfortunately, we have experienced situations where freelancers claimed to have professional design experience, but the quality of their work did not match their promises.



For this reason, we place great importance on portfolios and examples of actual work.



Please do not apply simply because you know how to use Canva or another design tool.



We want someone who understands professional editorial design and can demonstrate that through previous projects.



Examples of previously published magazine designs, editorial spreads, or similar professional work are strongly preferred.



Want to Stand Out? Show Us Your Vision!



We would love to see how you envision a premium online whisky magazine.



Applicants who include a sample design of 1–2 magazine pages will have an advantage during our selection process.



This could be a magazine cover, an editorial page, or a 2-page spread showing your creative interpretation of a whisky publication.



This is entirely optional, and we do not expect applicants to complete a full design project for free.



We simply want to get a better understanding of your creativity, design style, and ability to create a premium editorial experience.



A strong portfolio combined with an interesting visual concept will certainly catch our attention.



How to Apply



If you are interested, please send us:



Your portfolio, preferably including previously published magazines or editorial design projects.



A short introduction about yourself and your relevant design experience.



Which design software you prefer to use.



Your proposed fee within our $100–$150 budget.



Your estimated delivery time.



Whether you are interested in potential monthly design assignments.



Optional (applicants who include this will have an advantage): A 1–2 page sample showing how you envision our digital whisky magazine.



Please also explain why you believe you are the right designer for this project.



We are interested in your experience, creative approach, and ability to deliver professional work, not just general statements about your design skills.



What You Can Expect



Clear communication and constructive feedback



Creative freedom within the project's direction



The opportunity to contribute to a growing digital publication



Potential recurring monthly assignments



A professional and reliable long-term collaboration



We are looking for someone who combines creativity with professionalism and understands how to turn editorial content into a visually engaging digital magazine.



If you have experience designing magazines, a strong portfolio, and an eye for premium editorial design, we would love to hear from you!



We look forward to seeing your work and creative ideas.

title: Amazon Brand Protection Specialist: Unauthorized Sellers and Pending Trademark Brands
description:
MontBlack Inc. is an e-commerce distributor. We sell established consumer brands on Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop. Our brands are known and have real demand. Some have a trademark application that is still pending and no full Brand Registry access yet. We need an experienced specialist who can remove resellers and unauthorized sellers from these listings, and who can help move each brand into Brand Registry faster.



What you will do



Audit each listing and map every seller: stock, price, Buy Box share, and when they first appeared.

Separate legitimate resellers from counterfeit, unauthorized, and hijacker offers.

Remove sellers on brands without a registered trademark, using the methods Amazon still accepts: authorization and distribution records, listing and condition violations, and policy complaints backed by evidence.

Advise on the fastest path to Brand Registry access while the application is pending.

Once access is granted, file and manage cases through Brand Registry, Report a Violation, and Amazon’s other brand protection tools.



Handle Amazon’s responses and appeals, including the case where Amazon says a seller is “authorized by the brand.”

Run test buys and record lot codes, expiration dates, and condition problems when a case needs proof.

Trace where resellers buy their stock so the brand can cut supply at the source.

Work with our legal counsel on cease and desist letters when a seller does not leave.

Send a weekly report: sellers removed, sellers remaining, cases open.



What you need



At least 2 to 3 years of hands-on Amazon brand enforcement.

Proven results on brands with a pending trademark and limited or no Brand Registry access. This is the experience we care about most.

Working knowledge of Brand Registry, Report a Violation, Project Zero, Transparency, and how Amazon reviews and rejects cases.

Strong written English and clear case documentation.

Comfortable using Keepa or a similar tool to track sellers and stock.



Nice to have



Experience with food and consumable brands.

Experience working with trademark counsel.



Who should not apply



General virtual assistants and generalist Amazon consultants.

Agencies sending a template proposal.

Anyone without direct removal results they can describe in detail.



What we are looking for

Someone who brings solutions to remove resellers from our brands’ Amazon listings. Tell us what you would do and how fast you can do it.



To apply

Apply through this job post. Start your application with this exact title as the first line:

Brand Protection: Pending Trademark: [Your Name]



Applications that do not start with this title will not be read.



Include the following:



Three removal cases on brands with a pending or no trademark. For each one: brand type, number of sellers, method, timeline, and result. Remove any brand names.

Your answer to this question: “A brand has a pending trademark application and Brand Registry access. 20 resellers hold 100 or more units each, and Amazon says the brand authorized them. What do you do in the first 30 days?”

Your answer to this question: “Name two tactics most people overlook when handling Brand Registry or enforcement, and when you use each one.”

Your years of experience, your rate, your time zone, and how many cases you can take per week.



We review every application that follows the format. Shortlisted candidates get a 20 minute call and a short trial task on a live listing. We reply within 2 business days.
salary: 7-11 USD PER HOUR OR PER GIG

title: FULL-TIME ONLINE FITNESS COACH & CLIENT PERFORMANCE SPECIALIST
description:
ABOUT OC360 FITNESS



OC360 Fitness is a United States-based online fitness coaching company that specializes in helping busy professional men ages 40–55 build muscle, reduce body fat, increase strength, and improve their overall physical fitness.



Our primary clients are busy engineering managers, directors, and professionals who want outstanding results without spending countless hours at the gym.



Our signature coaching program, the OC360 Aesthetic Athlete System™, is a premium 12-week online fitness coaching program priced at $2,997.



We combine structured strength training, practical nutrition strategies, personalized accountability, and progress monitoring to help clients build stronger, healthier bodies.



We are seeking a dedicated, knowledgeable, and professional Part-Time Online Fitness Coach & Client Performance Specialist based in the Philippines to help deliver an exceptional client coaching experience.



This is a long-term growth opportunity for a qualified fitness coach who wants to help build a growing international online fitness company.



POSITION OVERVIEW



The Online Fitness Coach will work directly with the founder to implement personalized exercise programs, monitor client progress, provide fitness and nutrition education, and help clients achieve their agreed fitness goals.



The ideal candidate has experience coaching clients remotely, understands strength training and fat-loss principles, communicates professionally in English, and is comfortable using fitness coaching software.



This is a genuine fitness coaching position, not simply an administrative virtual assistant role.



PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Personal Training & Exercise Programming



Create and customize resistance-training programs using OC360 Fitness coaching frameworks.



Design efficient strength-training routines appropriate for each client's abilities and goals.



Implement 3-day, 4-day, or other approved training schedules.



Provide exercise substitutions for home and gym environments.



Review client workout logs and training performance.



Recommend appropriate changes to training volume, intensity, and progression.



Provide exercise demonstrations and technique feedback using video when appropriate.



Help clients improve exercise consistency and adherence.



2. Client Progress Monitoring



Conduct weekly client progress reviews.



Track body weight, body measurements, workout completion, and strength improvements.



Review client-reported nutrition and activity records.



Identify clients who are struggling with consistency.



Document progress throughout the 12-week coaching program.



Prepare concise progress reports for the founder.



Escalate concerns that require the founder's attention.



3. Nutrition Education & Meal Planning Support



Help clients follow approved OC360 Fitness nutrition guidelines.



Provide general education about protein intake, calorie balance, and food choices.



Assist clients in using OC360 Fitness grocery lists and meal-planning resources.



Provide practical suggestions for meal preparation, dining out, and business travel.



Monitor nutrition adherence and identify barriers to consistency.



Refer medical nutrition concerns or requests for therapeutic diets to appropriately licensed professionals.



4. Client Accountability & Communication



Send personalized weekly check-in messages.



Provide encouragement, accountability, and constructive feedback.



Answer client questions about their assigned fitness programs.



Participate in scheduled Zoom coaching sessions when required.



Follow up with clients who miss scheduled workouts or check-ins.



Maintain a professional, supportive, and respectful communication style.



Respond to routine client messages within one business day during agreed working coverage.



5. Fitness Coaching Software Management



Maintain accurate client records inside ABC Trainerize or the company's designated coaching platform.



Assign and update approved training programs.



Review workout logs, compliance reports, and progress records.



Upload or organize exercise demonstrations and educational resources.



Maintain clear coaching notes for client continuity.



Use Google Sheets, Google Drive, Zoom, and other approved tools as needed.



6. Client Results & Coaching Quality



Help clients establish realistic, measurable fitness goals.



Identify adherence problems and propose practical solutions.



Maintain consistent coaching standards across assigned clients.



Work collaboratively with the founder on client program adjustments.



Collect client feedback to improve coaching quality.



Document client success stories only with appropriate permission.



Protect client information and maintain confidentiality.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Personal training certification from NASM, ACE, ISSA, ACSM, NSCA, or a comparable recognized organization.



At least 1–2 years of relevant fitness coaching experience preferred.



Solid knowledge of resistance training, progressive overload, fat-loss principles, and exercise technique.



Experience providing personalized accountability and coaching feedback.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for remote coaching.



Ability to conduct professional Zoom calls.



Willingness to follow established OC360 Fitness coaching standards.



Commitment to client safety, confidentiality, and professional boundaries.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience using ABC Trainerize, Everfit, or comparable online coaching software.



Experience coaching men ages 40 and older.



Familiarity with body recomposition, strength development, and training around busy professional schedules.



Previous work with U.S., Canadian, Australian, or international fitness clients.



Experience preparing weekly progress and accountability reports.



Experience with remote fitness coaching or online personal training businesses.



WORK SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



Schedule: Approximately 15 hours weekly.



Monthly Pay: $500–$700 USD, based on qualifications and experience.



Recommended Starting Pay: $600 USD per month.



The initial coaching workload will be limited to an appropriate number of clients based on available hours, service requirements, and coaching complexity.



Compensation and responsibilities will be reviewed after the first 90 days. Additional paid hours may be offered as the coaching business grows.



The position begins part-time, with potential opportunities for expanded responsibilities and leadership.



The final working arrangement, benefits, and payment terms will be established in accordance with applicable employment requirements.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success in this position will be evaluated through:



Weekly Check-In Completion: Target at least 95% of scheduled client check-ins completed on time.



Client Communication: Respond to routine inquiries within one business day during agreed coverage.



Coaching Accuracy: Maintain properly assigned training programs and accurate records.



Client Accountability: Identify missed workouts and engagement problems promptly.



Client Results: Track measurable client progress toward individualized goals.



Professionalism: Maintain strong communication, confidentiality, and coaching standards.



These targets will be reviewed against actual client workload and available working hours.



FIRST 30 DAYS



The selected candidate will complete a structured onboarding period.



Week 1: Learn the OC360 Fitness brand, coaching philosophy, training system, and client management procedures.



Week 2: Learn the coaching software, review sample client programs, and practice preparing progress reports.



Week 3: Begin assisting with approved client check-ins and program updates under founder supervision.



Week 4: Manage an agreed initial client workload, demonstrate accurate coaching documentation, and participate in a performance review.



CAREER GROWTH: HEAD OF PERFORMANCE



Successful candidates may eventually advance into the position of Head of Performance — OC360 Fitness.



Potential future responsibilities include:



Supervising additional online fitness coaches.



Managing coaching delivery and quality assurance.



Improving OC360 Fitness programming systems.



Monitoring client outcomes across the company.



Training and onboarding new coaches.



Developing scalable coaching procedures.



Reporting coaching performance directly to the founder.



Promotion will depend on demonstrated leadership, coaching quality, business growth, and operational needs.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide the following:



Your resume or professional profile.



Copies or details of your fitness certifications.



A short video introducing yourself in English.



Your previous experience coaching clients online.



A description of your experience with Trainerize or similar software.



Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



Your weekly availability and ability to coordinate with Pacific Time.



An example of how you helped a client improve strength, lose body fat, or maintain workout consistency.



Practical screening question:



A 45-year-old engineering manager trains three times per week but has difficulty following his nutrition plan due to frequent business meetings.



How would you help him improve consistency without overwhelming his schedule?



Please explain your approach in 150–250 words.



Application Subject: OC360 Fitness — Online Fitness Coach Application



We are looking for a dependable, knowledgeable, compassionate, and highly organized fitness professional who wants to build a long-term career with OC360 Fitness.



OC360 FITNESS



Strength Built. Results Driven.

title: reator Outreach Assistant
description:
Hiring: Creator Outreach Assistant | Travel & Expat Community



Remote | Part-Time | Contract | $5 USD per Hour



Help Us Build a Global Travel Community



Are you someone who enjoys watching travel YouTubers, discovering interesting people, and learning about life in different countries?



Do you love hearing stories about people who packed their bags, moved abroad, and completely changed their lives?



If so, we’d love to hear from you!



VoyaKin is looking for a friendly, organized, and detail-oriented Creator Outreach Assistant to help us connect with travel creators, expats, and people sharing their experiences of living abroad.



This isn’t a traditional sales job. You’ll be helping us introduce people to a growing travel community built around exploration, belonging, and meaningful human connections.



About VoyaKin



VoyaKin (
) is a brand-new, African American-owned travel community platform for iPhone, Android, and the web.



Founded by Darius Henry and owned by Stockhouse Films, VoyaKin was created around one powerful idea:



“Belong Somewhere, Not Just Go Somewhere.”



Our mission is to help people discover what’s possible beyond their home country, challenge misconceptions about international travel, and connect with others who have already experienced life abroad.



VoyaKin brings together country-based communities called Circles, travel guides, trip planning, social feeds, messaging with translation, and verified travel passports.



Our initial Circles include Ghana, Thailand, Vietnam, Mexico, Costa Rica, Colombia, Portugal, South Africa, Kenya, Panama, Senegal, Brazil, The Gambia, Tanzania, and Indonesia.



The app is free for travelers, and we’re currently in an early launch and beta phase.



What You’ll Be Doing



1. Discover Interesting Travel Creators



* Search YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok for people who document traveling, relocating, retiring, or living abroad.

* Focus especially on African American and diaspora creators, while welcoming authentic travel experiences from all backgrounds.

* Use our built-in Creator Finder to discover relevant channels.

* Review creator profiles, engagement, content, and AI-generated fit scores.

* Add qualified creators to our Creator CRM, avoiding duplicates.



2. Research Each Creator



* Claim creators from our shared outreach pool to avoid duplicate contact.

* Use our AI-powered Research & Draft tool to understand their background and travel journey.

* Watch or review relevant videos to understand their experiences.

* Identify what makes each person’s story interesting and relevant to VoyaKin.



3. Send Personalized Invitations



* Invite suitable creators to explore VoyaKin as founding members or ambassadors for their country’s Circle.

* Start with AI-generated outreach drafts and improve them with genuine personal details.

* Write warm, friendly, professional messages that sound human.

* Contact creators through publicly available business
s, Instagram DMs, or other appropriate public contact methods.

* Personally review and send every message. Outreach is never sent automatically.



4. Manage Conversations and Follow-Ups



* Record outreach activity and responses in our built-in CRM.

* Track creators through stages from Found and Contacted to Interested and Joined VoyaKin.

* Follow up politely when appropriate, typically after five days, with a maximum of two follow-ups.

* Respect requests not to be contacted.

* Keep claimed creators active; inactive claims return to the shared pool after seven days.



5. Help Build Relationships



* Respond to basic questions about VoyaKin.

* Share early-access information when appropriate.

* Introduce interested creators to the founder for next steps.

* Provide feedback about which outreach approaches generate meaningful conversations.



6. Help Creators Become Active Community Members



* Guide interested creators through signing up for VoyaKin.

* Encourage new members to introduce themselves and share their first authentic travel-related post.

* Help creators discover and participate in their relevant country Circles.

* Follow up with newly registered creators when appropriate to answer questions or offer assistance.

* Track registrations, first posts, and community participation in the available admin tools.

* Share feedback about obstacles that prevent creators from joining or participating.



Our Goal Is Real Community Growth



Success isn’t measured simply by how many creators you contact. Our goal is to bring real travelers and content creators into VoyaKin who genuinely want to participate in our community.



You’ll help guide interested creators from their initial invitation through registration and their first post.



Our initial monthly targets are:



* 5–10 new creator registrations on VoyaKin.

* 3–6 registered creators publishing their first original post.



These goals will be reviewed and adjusted based on actual outreach results.



We value genuine engagement, meaningful relationships, and quality content over inflated numbers or spam.



We want creators to join because they believe in what we’re building, not because they feel pressured to register or publish content.



Tools You’ll Use



You’ll work primarily inside the VoyaKin admin dashboard.



Our system includes:



* Creator Finder

* AI-assisted creator research and message drafting

* Creator CRM and recruitment pipeline

* Outreach tracking and follow-up reminders

* Personal activity tracking



You’ll also use YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, and social messaging.



Training is provided. No coding or technical development experience is required.



Your admin access is limited to outreach functions. You will not have access to app users’ private information, private messages, payments, advertising, or administrative settings. Actions within the admin system are logged.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re especially interested in someone who:



* Has excellent written English and communicates naturally.

* Enjoys researching people, cultures, and travel experiences.

* Understands how YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok work.

* Is organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.

* Can manage multiple conversations without losing track.

* Follows instructions and works independently.

* Understands that quality matters more than sending hundreds of generic messages.

* Respects privacy, platform guidelines, and people’s decisions.



Nice to Have, but Not Required



* Previous experience in influencer outreach, virtual assistance, or community management.

* Familiarity with international travel, expats, or digital nomad communities.

* Experience using CRM systems.

* Knowledge of African American travel communities or the African diaspora.

* Additional language skills, especially French, Spanish, Portuguese, Thai, or Vietnamese.



How We’ll Measure Success



We care about meaningful connections, not just message volume.



Performance indicators include:



* [x] new qualified creators identified weekly

* [x] personalized messages sent weekly

* Creator response rates

* 5–10 new creator registrations monthly

* 3–6 creators publishing their first original post monthly

* Continued participation from recruited creators

* Accurate and current CRM records

* Professional communication and consistent follow-through



Targets will be adjustable as we learn what works best.



Position Details



Company: VoyaKin



Website: 



Location: Remote



Employment type: Part-time / Contract



Hours: 20–30 hours per week



Compensation: $5 USD per hour



Start date: ASAP



Our Values



We believe in honesty, authenticity, and treating people with respect.



We never exaggerate our platform’s size, pressure creators, purchase contact lists, scrape private information, or send mass-produced spam.



Every creator deserves thoughtful, personal communication.



We’d love to meet someone who wants to help introduce people to an amazing world of travel, cultural discovery, and global friendships.



VoyaKin — Belong Somewhere, Not Just Go Somewhere.

Cornell Coaching Technologies is looking for an experienced, reliable, and results-driven Collections Agent to join our growing team.



The successful candidate will be responsible for following up with businesses regarding outstanding balances, communicating professionally, negotiating payment arrangements, and ensuring timely payment collection.



Important: We will ONLY consider applicants with relevant previous work experience in collections, debt recovery, accounts receivable, or a similar role. Applicants without relevant work experience will not be considered.



Responsibilities



Contact customers with overdue or outstanding balances through phone calls,
s, and other communication channels.



Follow up on unpaid invoices and pending payments.

Qualifications

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.



Comfortable making outbound calls and handling difficult conversations.



Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.



Highly organized and detail-oriented.



Able to work independently and meet performance targets.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Job Title:** Part-Time Digital Marketing Coordinator — Social Media & SEO (Buffer + SEMrush + Claude AI)
description:
Job Type:** Part-Time / Work From Home

**Compensation:** Monthly Rate (Negotiable — Based on Experience and Scope)

**Location:** Remote — Philippines-based applicants preferred



---



**About the Company**



We are a national business brokerage firm based in the United States. We help business owners sell their businesses and train licensed real estate agents to become professional business brokers. We are a growing, professional company building our brand presence on LinkedIn,
, and YouTube, and strengthening our organic search presence through smart SEO.



---



**About the Role**



This is not a standard social media job. We are looking for a skilled, self-directed Digital Marketing Coordinator who can handle both social media management and search engine optimization — using professional tools and working within a structured approval system.



You will be given a Claude AI team seat for content creation, access to Buffer for scheduling, and access to SEMrush for SEO and content intelligence. You will be expected to use all three tools together to build our audience, grow our online presence, and drive real results over time.



If you only know how to post content and have no SEO experience, this role is not for you. If you can do both — and do both well — we want to hear from you.



---



**Important — Account Security**



Our 
 and
 accounts are brand new. We are starting from zero and need to grow our audience aggressively but intelligently. We have had previous social media accounts shut down due to overseas team members logging in directly from foreign IP addresses. That will not happen again.



You will never log in directly to our 
 or
 accounts. All content and scheduling activity on those platforms must go through Buffer only. Connection requests on LinkedIn will be handled separately by a US-based team member. Your job is content, scheduling, SEO, and engagement — all managed through the approved tools.



If you do not understand why this matters or cannot commit to it, please do not apply.



---



**What You Will Do**



**Social Media — Daily and Weekly**

- Write daily social media content for LinkedIn,
, and YouTube using Claude AI, keeping everything tightly aligned with our company message and voice

- Build and maintain a consistent posting calendar and schedule all content through Buffer

- Submit all content to management for review and approval before anything is published — no exceptions

- Monitor and respond to comments and messages across all platforms professionally and promptly, in our voice

- Format and prepare videos for YouTube,
, and LinkedIn — proper dimensions, thumbnails, captions, descriptions, and hashtags

- For YouTube, you may be given direct upload access; all other platforms are managed exclusively through Buffer



**SEO — Weekly and Monthly**

- Use SEMrush to research keywords our target audience is actively searching for and build our content calendar around those terms

- Monitor the search rankings of our website pages and report on progress weekly

- Identify on-page SEO opportunities — weak page titles, missing meta descriptions, thin content — and flag them to our web team for implementation

- Research competitors to identify content gaps and opportunities we can own

- Conduct backlink audits using SEMrush and identify quality directories, publications, and websites for outreach

- Perform monthly link building outreach — directory submissions and targeted guest post or mention pitches

- Optimize every YouTube video title, description, and tags for YouTube search

- Monitor our domain authority and backlink profile growth over time

- Deliver a monthly SEO report covering rankings, traffic trends, backlink growth, and what moved the needle



---



**What We Require**



- Proven experience managing social media for a professional brand — please provide examples or a portfolio

- Hands-on experience with Buffer or a comparable scheduling platform

- Working knowledge of SEMrush — keyword research, backlink tools, competitor analysis, and rank tracking

- Experience optimizing content and YouTube videos for search

- Experience with link building outreach — directory submissions and publisher or blog pitches

- Experience using Claude or ChatGPT for content creation

- Experience formatting video content for LinkedIn,
, and YouTube

- Strong written English — professional, clean, and free of grammar errors

- Ability to work within a strict approval workflow — nothing goes live without sign-off

- Deep knowledge of LinkedIn account safety — what triggers restrictions, how to warm up a new account, and how to grow without getting flagged

- Experience managing community engagement — responding to comments and messages on behalf of a brand

- Self-motivated, organized, and consistent — this role requires daily attention and monthly reporting



**Nice to Have**

- Background in financial services, real estate, or business consulting

- Experience with Canva or similar tools for graphics

- Experience growing a LinkedIn Company Page from scratch

- Familiarity with Google Search Console alongside SEMrush



---



**What We Provide**

- A Claude AI team seat for all content creation

- Access to Buffer for scheduling and publishing

- Access to SEMrush for SEO and content intelligence

- All video assets and brand materials — you are not starting from nothing

- Clear approval workflows — no guessing what to post or what direction to go

- Stable, ongoing part-time work with a growing US-based firm



---



**How to Apply**



Please send the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your experience in both social media management and SEO

2. Examples of accounts or content you have managed — screenshots or links

3. Your experience with Buffer or other scheduling tools

4. Your experience with SEMrush — specifically which features you use regularly

We are looking for someone who is skilled, dependable, and takes both social media and SEO seriously as a craft. If that is you, we would love to hear from you.
