title: Cybersecurity Lead (Application and Infrastructure Security), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained.



ABOUT MSTR



MSTR is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise companies.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Security work is currently shared by our infra and DevOps teams, alongside their main jobs. We want one person to own it end to end, set the standard, and be able to block a release.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. You start as our security lead and build this into a small department over time.



LOCATION AND WORKING SET-UP

- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 3:00 p.m - 12:00 a.m Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Dependency and supply-chain hygiene across all repos: Dependabot or Renovate, npm/pip/NuGet audits, SBOMs, a fixed patch cadence, and triaging what is actually exploitable

- Pentesting our own products and the custom builds for clients, before release and on a recurring schedule

- Security checks in CI: SAST, secrets scanning, container and IaC scanning, and DAST against staging

- Cloud and platform posture on Azure and Supabase: identity and access, row-level security (RLS), network exposure, key management

- AI-specific risks: prompt injection, MCP and tool permissions, data leaking through LLM calls, and which model providers may see client data

- Own i
 response and a vulnerability disclosure process

- Support enterprise security questionnaires and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 readiness)

- Build security into a small department over time and set the rules the developers follow



HOW WE SPLIT THE WORK

- DevOps runs the platform. Security sets policy, finds issues, checks the fixes, and has veto on releases.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-have:

- At least 4 years in application security or pentesting, with real findings you can walk us through

- Strong grip on the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM Top 10

- Hands-on with Burp Suite or similar

- Can read and fix code in our stacks: TypeScript/React/Next, Python, .NET, Postgres

- Azure security experience

- Supabase experience

- You write clear findings that a developer can act on and a client can read

- You take ownership without being chased. This is a lead role, not an assistant role.

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal



Nice-to-have:

- OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or an Azure security certification

- A bug bounty track record

- Has gone through ISO 27001 or SOC 2 with a company

- Has used Claude Code for security review



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code or similar tools for code review or security work, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the security function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real authority: you have veto on releases

- Interesting problems: application, infrastructure and AI security in one role

- A clear growth path: build and lead a small security department

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



OUR STACK

- Cloud and platform: Azure, Supabase

- Languages and frameworks: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, .NET

- Database: Postgres



HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into application security.

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

 subject: "Security Lead Application - [Your Name]"

WHO SHOULD APPLY

title: Professional Video Editors Wanted: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro
description:
Our Requirements



Professional video editors wanted for long-term roles at our company.



MUST HAVE EXPERTISE AND ACTIVE LICENSE:

Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Avid Media Composer, or similar. 



ADDITIONAL EXPERTISE AND ACTIVE LICENSE:

Adobe After Effects, DaVinci Resolve’s Fusion Page, Adobe Audition or Pro Tools - OR - similar



PLUS

Adobe Photoshop or simliar







MUST HAVE

An active license for each software program you use. Proof is required.

7+ years of paid, professional video editing experience with real clients.

Outstanding spoken and written English skills.

Availability overlapping 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Chicago time, plus our Tuesday team meeting from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM Chicago time.



NOTE

Our round 1 interview includes a live editing demo.

J-cuts and L-cuts

Match cuts and cutting on action

Custom keyframed animation with easing

Masking and motion tracking

Sound design synced to cuts and animations

Color correction and color grading

Hooks and pacing for short form, story structure for long form





About Ice Cream Sunshine

Ice Cream Sunshine is a good vibes signature ice cream tour and special events company based in Chicago. Good vibes, excellence, and fun are the core of who we are and that extends to every person on our team.



We lead delicious ice cream walking tours in Chicago’s iconic neighborhoods where guests: learn about the city, discover fun facts about the neighborhood, gain insights into the world of ice cream, and enjoy delicious treats along the way.





HOW TO APPLY: INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING IN YOUR MESSAGE TO OUR TEAM

1. A brief cover letter about your expertise in the required software.

2. Link to your portfolio using the required software.

3. Link to your resume.

4 A link to a 60 to 90 second video where you talk about your favorite ice cream and what you love about being a video editor. Start your video with "Hello Ice Cream Sunshine". 



Incomplete applications will not be considered.



Our Hiring Process



Round 1: Top candidates receive a short skills survey.

Round 2: live editing demo.

Round 3: final interview. 

note:

We verify past work and check professional references.



Pay and Growth



$6 to $9 per hour to start, plus bonuses. Some bonuses are guaranteed and some are performance based.



Based on performance and business needs: rate increases (target: the first 30 to 90 days), more hours or full time work, and growth into a lead role.



Everyone at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always and delicious ice cream too. 🍦
